# OpenKai2 Display

A launcher font derived from Bangers Regular by the Bangers Project Authors.
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt.

The outlines and character coverage are unchanged. The family is renamed,
Windows ascent and descent follow the original typographic metrics, and the
USE_TYPO_METRICS flag is enabled. This gives GDI controls and wrapped labels
consistent line spacing without clipping ordinary text.

Source: ../bangers/Bangers-Regular.ttf
Regenerate with `python tools/native/prepare-launcher-font.py` (fontTools).
